purpose: Focused official-executable probes for guide/source discrepancies after complete CO schema coverage.

probes.question: Does the official executable accept, overwrite, or reject a repeated OZONEFIL for one sector?
probes.result: Two distinct-sector OZONEFIL records completed successfully. Two different files assigned to the same sector were rejected with CO E501 from O3FILE.

probes.question: Does the official executable accept, overwrite, or reject a repeated NOX_FILE for one sector?
probes.result: Two distinct-sector NOX_FILE records completed successfully. Two different files assigned to the same sector were rejected with CO E501 from NOXFILE.

probes.question: How does the official executable handle repeated ARCFTOPT and more than one payload field?
probes.result: A complete aircraft control, ARCFTOPT without a payload, repeated same-ID and different-ID ARCFTOPT cards, and ARCFTOPT with an extra payload field all completed. The source assigns AFTID(1) only when IFC equals 3, so a one-payload repeat is last-assignment-wins while no-payload or extra-field cards are preserved but do not assign AFTID(1). Aircraft dependencies were also retained: E198 without ALPHA, E204 with DFAULT, E821 without ARCFTOPT, E822 without ARCFTSRC, and E823 without preceding HOUREMIS.
probes.boundary: The six-hour positive fixture uses POLLUTID OTHER to avoid an unrelated annual criteria-pollutant completeness check. Last-assignment-wins is a source-state conclusion because the official output does not expose AFTID directly.

probes.question: Which final diagnostic is emitted for incomplete temporal vectors by flag and scope?
probes.result: Complete global and sector-scoped MONTH vectors were accepted. An 11-of-12 O3VALUES vector was rejected with CO E261, and an 11-of-12 NOX_VALS vector was rejected with CO E603. Sector diagnostics identify O3SECTn or NOXSCTn. The official source uses the same accumulated-count versus flag-derived-required-maximum branches for supported temporal flags.
probes.boundary: The official executable cases use MONTH as the representative time flag; cross-flag behavior is supported by the retained source branches and the existing flag-specific cardinality table rather than by enumerating every flag through the executable.

probes.question: Confirm official executable diagnostics for no-ALPHA and DFAULT conflicts.
probes.result: All seven dedicated ALPHA controls completed. Official source gives E196 with DFAULT and E198 without ALPHA for GDSEASON, GASDEPDF, GDLANUSE, and GASDEPVD; LOW_WIND has an immediate E133 branch without ALPHA. DFAULT plus ALPHA produced target E133, E122, and E123 for LOW_WIND, AWMADWNW, and ORD_DWNW respectively. Complete aircraft sources produced E198 without ALPHA and E198/E204 under DFAULT plus ALPHA.
probes.boundary: The no-ALPHA allsrcs decks also contain RLINEXT and their observed E198 alone is not attributed to every injected target. Target-specific no-ALPHA rules are promoted only where the exact official source branches are retained.
